description: A token's supply as a flow, month by month: the sellable pile (circulating and not locked, plus staked tokens free to leave), what comes in (vesting tranches, unlocks, rewards), what goes out (buybacks, burns), the yearly change of the pile in % (the hero number) and the pressure number 1-10 (10 = buyers squeeze the pile, 1 = new tokens flood it; 8-10 Squeezing, 4-7 Balanced, 1-3 Flooding) with its range when an input is unknown. Pass symbol (a Gem Screener coin's ticker, slug or CoinGecko id; a ticker two tokens share answers AMBIGUOUS_TICKER with the options) OR contract + chain (any token; price from DeFiLlama, totalSupply from the chain). The record carries inputs[] (value, unit, source, as_of), unknown_names[], months[] (pile, in by kind, out by kind, the seven pie slices, yearly_pct, pressure), next_unlock, dilution_week_pct and refreshed_at. From EventTrader's Supply Analyzer (cymetica.com/supply-analyzer). Every input carries its value, unit, source and date; unknown inputs are named, never zero. A measure of the token's supply, not a forecast of its price. Read-only, no key. Not financial advice.

chain.description: Chain of the contract: ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, avalanche (needed with contract)

contract.description: Token contract address (identifies the token exactly)

symbol.description: Ticker, slug or CoinGecko id of a Gem Screener coin
